svg.text: tt_um_hma_zirh2 on the Tiny Tapeout harness - every named box is an RTL instance - dashed red = event/error paths
costs an event, not the CPU
events close in time -> burst bin,
hardware-owned - the CPU cannot block it
The placement experiment: ring TMR A's replicas are macro-bound 680-1380 um apart; ring TMR B is the tool-placed control.
ESCAPE(A) vs ESCAPE(B) under beam is the registered, falsifiable prediction (docs/PREDICTION.md).

Programming: the ISP loader runs code written after tape-out (test/test_isp.py). Still deliberately absent: QSPI-MRAM and the debug module - built and verified for the next chip (docs/ZIRH3-SCOPE.md).
